Mixed purées

Asparagus and potato with cheese

Spárgás burgonya sajttal

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

All 4 portions share 30 g of cheese. Serve warm. This contains milk.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 280 g new potatoes (peeled weight)
  • 120 g asparagus (tender part only, woody ends snapped off)
  • 30 g pasteurised mild full-fat cheese (a small handful grated, shared across all 4 portions; milk allergen)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks.
  2. Snap the woody ends off the asparagus and use the tender part.
  3. Boil potatoes and asparagus in unsalted water until the stalks squash easily.
  4. Drain, keeping a spoon of cooking water.
  5. Add the grated cheese and blend until smooth.
  6. Do not add more cheese, and do not add salt.

Adjusted

Asparagus stays fibrous if it is not cooked very soft. Cheese is salty, so a large amount is too much sodium at this age.

Cook new potato and asparagus until the stalks squash easily, then blend. Use only a small handful of pasteurised mild cheese grated across 4 portions.
